A '''Sith cult''' formed by the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Unidentified Kursid species|species]] that [[Homeworld/Legends|inhabited]] the the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kursid]] following the arrival of members of the [[Order of the Sith Lords]]. It was centered on the periodic returns of members of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane's]] lineage that took place for six [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] murdered Kursid's natives, who were buried by the cult. It offered corpses, [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], art, and other goods to the Sith in an arid [[Kursid arid plateau|plateau]]. The organization built several [[Sith starship replicas|replicas]] of Sith [[Starship/Legends|starships]] on the plateau before [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous's]] visit as an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]<ref name="DP" /> by [[124 BBY]].<ref name="Note 1">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] establishes that the [[Sith starship replicas]] on [[Kursid]] had been built by the [[Time/Legends|time]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] during [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprenticeship]] to his [[Darth Tenebrous's Sith Master|Sith Master]]. Furthermore, {{InsiderCite|130|The Tenebrous Way}} establishes that, after Tenebrous had [[Death/Legends|killed]] his master, he undertook a [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]-long search for an apprentice of his own before becoming the master of [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], which per ''Darth Plagueis'' had occurred by the time Tenebrous and Plagueis visited Kursid approximately fifty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]]. Therefore, Tenebrous must have visited Kursid by approximately [[124 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The cult appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']].<ref name="DP" />
